title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
清晨，阿地和爸爸坐上开往阿里山的小火车。阿地手中
紧紧握着一个旧旧的小袋子，里面装着一月干枯的樱花瓣。
page_text_en: In the morning, Adi and his father boarded the small train heading to Alishan. Adi held tightly in his hand an old, worn-out small bag, inside which were dried cherry blossoms from January.
summary_zh: 清晨，阿地和爸爸乘坐小火车前往阿里山，阿地手中紧握着装有干枯樱花瓣的旧袋子，画面右侧展现了城市与山林交界的景象。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
这是奶奶最宝贝的东西，她总是小心地拿出樱花瓣，对阿地说：‘在山上时，当我闻到青草发出清香，感觉泥土变得温暖的时候，我就一直在等。’
‘等什么呢？’阿地好奇地问。
‘等满月樱花祭啊。在冬天最后一个满月时，所有的好朋友都会回到樱花树下，高兴地唱歌跳舞，等待樱花精灵唤醒沉睡的春神，让春天又回到人间。’奶奶躺在床上，眯着眼睛微微笑。
奶奶还告诉阿地，这片樱花瓣是她下山时，一群很特别的朋友送给她的礼物。
page_text_en:
This is Grandma's most precious thing. She always carefully takes out the cherry blossom petals and tells Adi, 'When I'm up in the mountains, as soon as I smell the fresh scent of grass and feel the soil warming up, I've been waiting all along.'
'Waiting for what?' Adi asks curiously.
'Waiting for the Full Moon Cherry Blossom Festival. On the last full moon of winter, all my dear friends will return to the cherry blossom trees, happily singing and dancing, waiting for the cherry blossom spirit to awaken the sleeping Spring God, bringing spring back to the world.' Grandma lies in bed, smiling gently with her eyes half-closed.
Grandma also tells Adi that these cherry blossom petals were a gift from a group of very special friends when she came down the mountain.
summary_zh: 阿地和奶奶在火车上，奶奶向阿地讲述樱花瓣的来历和满月樱花祭的传说，画面右侧是火车穿行于阿里山森林的景象。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
奶奶已经病了很久了，阿地和她约好一起
回到阿里山，参加满月樱花祭，但是奶奶却说
话不算数，自己先走了。
每次摸着这个小袋子，阿地就会想起奶奶，
他又生气又难过。
小火车慢慢地往上爬，绕过一圈又一圈的
绿色山林，阿地终于回到奶奶的阿里山。
page_text_en:
Grandma had been sick for a long time. Adi and she had promised to go back to Alishan together to attend the Full Moon Cherry Blossom Festival, but Grandma broke her promise and passed away first.
Every time he touched this small bag, Adi would think of Grandma, and he would feel both angry and sad.
The little train slowly climbed upward, winding around circle after circle of green mountains, and finally Adi arrived at Grandma's Alishan.
summary_zh: 阿地回忆奶奶病重离世，他带着装有干枯樱花瓣的小袋子，乘坐小火车历经蜿蜒山路，终于回到奶奶的阿里山。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
这是阿地第一次到阿里山，夜晚的阿里山很安静，只听见小虫子唧唧的叫声。阿地拿着奶奶的樱花瓣，站在樱花树下。
奶奶常说樱花盛开时，就像一朵朵美丽的小红云，飞舞在山林中。但是现在阿地看到的却是一棵棵光秃秃的樱花树。
“奶奶，您知道我帮您把樱花瓣带回来了吗？”
阿地把花瓣放在树枝上，想象樱花盛开的模样。
这时，一阵风吹过来，卷起树上的樱花瓣，花瓣随风飞舞，好像一只美丽的蝴蝶，往白雾弥漫的森林里飞去。
page_text_en:
This was Adi's first time in Alishan. The night in Alishan was very quiet, with only the chirping of little insects. Adi held his grandmother's cherry blossom petals and stood under the cherry tree.
Grandma often said that when cherry blossoms bloomed, they looked like beautiful little red clouds dancing in the mountains. But now, all Adi saw were cherry trees bare of leaves.
"Grandma, do you know I brought your cherry blossom petals back?"
Adi placed the petals on the branches, imagining how the blossoms would look when they bloomed.
At that moment, a breeze blew, lifting the petals from the tree. The petals danced in the wind, like a beautiful butterfly, flying into the misty forest.
summary_zh: 阿地第一次在夜晚来到阿里山，他将奶奶的樱花瓣放在光秃秃的樱花树上，一阵风吹过，花瓣随风飞向白雾弥漫的森林。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
阿地赶紧追过去。他跟着飞舞的花瓣，在白雾中绕来绕去，等到雾散，才发现自己来到森林深处，前面有一棵倒下来的神木。
巨大的树干中间有个又黑又深的树洞，不知道通往哪里。
花瓣飞进树洞中，阿地也紧跟着钻进去。他越往前爬，树洞越窄，只看见发着微光的樱花瓣直往前飞。
page_text_en:
Adi hurried after them. He followed the dancing petals, twisting and turning through the white mist. When the fog cleared, he realized he had reached the depths of the forest, where a giant fallen sacred tree lay ahead.
In the middle of the massive trunk was a dark and deep hollow, leading who knew where.
The petals flew into the hollow, and Adi followed closely behind. As he crawled deeper, the hollow grew narrower, and he could only see the faintly glowing cherry blossoms flying straight ahead.
summary_zh: 阿地跟随飞舞的樱花瓣进入森林深处，穿过一棵倒下的神木树洞，树洞幽深狭窄，花瓣在前方微光闪烁，引领他继续前行。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
阿地终于爬出树洞。飞舞的花瓣、轻轻落在他的手心。他的身旁有一堆大大小小的眼睛正瞪着他瞧。
“咦？这个小男孩儿手中的不是我们送给玛娜的樱花瓣吗？”
动物们又交头接耳地说。
“玛娜是我的。”阿地好惊讶，他居然可以和动物说话。
“哇！玛娜都当奶奶了，她离开山上时，还只是个小女孩儿呢！”
动物们惊呼着。
阿地这才明白，原来它们就是奶奶那群很特别的朋友。
page_text_en:
Ade finally crawled out of the tree hollow. Dancing petals gently landed in his palm. Around him, a cluster of big and small eyes stared at him.
"Huh? Isn't that the cherry blossom petal we gave to Mana, held by this little boy?" the animals whispered to each other.
"Mana is mine," Ade was amazed—he could actually talk to the animals.
"Wow! Mana has become a grandmother! When she left the mountain, she was just a little girl!" the animals exclaimed.
Ade finally understood: these were the very special friends his grandmother had.
summary_zh: 阿地从树洞中爬出，手中的樱花瓣引来一群动物的注意，它们认出花瓣是送给玛娜的，并惊讶于阿地能与它们对话，阿地这才明白这些动物是奶奶的特别朋友。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
“你们在这里做什么呢？”阿地好奇地问。
山猪抢着说：“都已经三月了，唤醒春神的樱花精灵还没来，满月樱花祭就要取消了，如果冬天继续留在山上，大家都会冻死、饿死，真不知道该怎么办！”
page_text_en:
"What are you all doing here?" asked Adi curiously.
The wild boar hurriedly replied, "It's already March! The cherry blossom spirits who wake the Spring God haven't arrived yet. The Full Moon Cherry Blossom Festival will be canceled. If winter stays on the mountain, everyone will freeze and starve to death. I don't know what to do!"
summary_zh: 阿地在森林中遇到一群动物，山猪告诉他，因为樱花精灵未到，春神未被唤醒，满月樱花祭面临取消，动物们担心冬天持续会冻饿而死。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，樱花瓣竟然发出强烈的光芒，
当阿地指尖轻触樱花瓣时，所有山林的记忆，
就像一股暖流，缓缓流向他的心中。
一个遥远而神秘的声音呼唤着：
“那族的孩子——阿地，月圆时，找到透着银光的珍珠，才能拯救生病的樱花精灵，让春天回到山上。”
page_text_en:
At this moment, the cherry blossom petals suddenly emitted a strong light.
When Adi gently touched the petals, memories of the entire forest,
like a warm current, slowly flowed into his heart.
A distant and mysterious voice called out:
"Child of that tribe—Adi, at the full moon, find the pearl that shines with silver light, only then can you save the sick cherry blossom spirit and bring spring back to the mountain."
summary_zh: 阿地触碰樱花瓣时，花瓣发出强光，唤醒了山林的记忆，一个神秘声音指引他必须在月圆时找到银光珍珠，才能拯救生病的樱花精灵，让春天重回山上。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
阿地发现手中的樱花瓣渐渐消失，化成一个樱花精灵，大家
担心地看着虚弱的樱花精灵，都失望地低下头，因为它们根本
不知道银光珍珠在哪里。
阿地却大声地说：“喂！你们一直住在这月山林里，所有的森
林和湖泊你们都去过，我相信只要有心，一定可以找到的！”
page_text_en:
Adi discovered that the cherry blossom petals in his hand were gradually disappearing, turning into a cherry blossom spirit. Everyone looked at the weak spirit with concern, and they all lowered their heads in disappointment, because they had no idea where the Silver Light Pearl was.
Adi, however, shouted loudly, "Hey! You've all lived in this Moon Mountain Forest. You've been to every forest and lake. I believe that as long as we try, we can definitely find it!"
summary_zh: 阿地手中的樱花瓣化作虚弱的樱花精灵，动物们因不知银光珍珠下落而失望，阿地鼓励大家只要用心一定能找到。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
动物们觉得阿地的话很有道理，大家决定
一起去寻找银光珍珠。
page_text_en:
The animals thought Adi's words made sense, so they decided
 to go together to find the silver light pearl.
summary_zh: 动物们认同阿地的说法，决定一起出发寻找银光珍珠。画面中阿地骑在熊背上，进入月夜下的森林，前方是幽深的山林和发光的植物。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh: 阿地跟着黑熊在森林里找了好久，发现一只山雀静静地站在断裂的树枝上，旁边散落一地的鸟巢，黑熊说这里原本有很多树木，不知道为什么一夜之间全倒了。望着山雀孤单的背影，阿地觉得很难过，但是他什么都不能做，只好跟着黑熊，默默往前走。
page_text_en: Adi followed the black bear through the forest for a long time, and discovered a mountain bird quietly perched on a broken branch, with scattered bird nests on the ground nearby. The bear said there used to be many trees here, but for some unknown reason, they all fell overnight. Looking at the bird's lonely back, Adi felt very sad, but he could do nothing, so he just followed the bear, walking silently forward.
summary_zh: 阿地和黑熊在森林中发现一片被毁坏的林地，一只山雀孤零零地站在断裂的树枝上，周围散落着鸟巢。黑熊解释树木一夜之间全倒，阿地感到难过却无能为力，只能默默跟随黑熊继续前行。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh: 森林里的小路十分难走，阿地老是被土石绊倒、被树枝刮伤。他痛得坐在地上，黑熊想找一点清水帮阿地清洗伤口，却发现小溪都被土石填平了。
page_text_en: The path through the forest was very difficult to walk. Adi kept tripping over rocks and getting scratched by branches. He sat on the ground in pain. The black bear tried to find some water to clean Adi's wounds, but discovered that the stream had been filled in by rocks and soil.
summary_zh: 阿地和黑熊在森林中艰难前行，阿地被土石和树枝弄伤，黑熊想为他清洗伤口，却发现小溪已被土石填平。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
阿地和黑熊继续前行。
阿地忽然发现前方空地，整片空地的树木仿佛
被风刮倒了似的倒在地上，树干横七竖八，枝叶散落一地
，他难过，只因看到树干断裂处露出的树皮是鲜红
的，像血一样。他蹲下身摸着树干，这时才发现
树皮是自己的心跳，一滴泪轻轻的滴落了下来。
在梦中的记忆中，森林的深处有银光珍珠。
page_text_en:
Ade and the black bear continued forward.
Ade suddenly noticed an open space ahead, where all the trees seemed to have been blown down, lying scattered on the ground with trunks crisscrossed and branches strewn everywhere.
He felt sad, for the exposed bark at the broken trunks was bright red, like blood. He crouched down and touched the trunk, and then realized the bark was beating with his own heartbeat. A single tear gently fell.
In the memory of his dream, deep in the forest, there was the Silver Light Pearl.
summary_zh: 阿地和黑熊在森林中发现一片被毁坏的林地，树干断裂处露出鲜红的树皮，阿地触碰树干时感受到心跳，流下眼泪，并回忆起梦中森林深处有银光珍珠。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
summary_zh: 画面展现了一幅梦幻的月夜樱花林景象，樱花精灵在花枝间飞舞，阿地凝视着这美景，似乎在回忆或憧憬着森林深处的银光珍珠。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
阵阵春风吹来了，天空飘落一阵樱花雨，
花瓣在空中飞舞、翻转、缓缓落到阿地的
手心，眼前出现一棵开满美丽花朵、闪闪发亮
的樱花树。
page_text_en:
A gentle spring breeze blew, and a shower of cherry blossoms fell from the sky.
Petals danced and twirled in the air, gently landing in Adi's hands.
Before him appeared a cherry tree, blooming with beautiful flowers, shimmering brightly.
summary_zh: 阿地在月夜下看到一片盛开的樱花林，花瓣如雨飘落，他伸手接住花瓣，眼前浮现一棵闪闪发亮的樱花树，仿佛实现了梦中的景象。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
大家觉得好开心，都跑到美丽的樱花树下唱歌、跳舞。
阿地笑了，今年的满月樱花祭就要开始了！
page_text_en:
Everyone felt so happy, running to the beautiful cherry blossom trees to sing and dance.
A-di smiled, "This year's Full Moon Cherry Blossom Festival is about to begin!"
summary_zh: 动物们在盛开的樱花树下欢庆，阿地微笑着宣布满月樱花祭即将开始。

title_en: The Forest Where the Spring Spirit Dances
source_file: 春神跳舞的森林(4-8 岁).ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
银色月光洒满阿里山，春神在森林里跳舞。
阿地微笑地说："好的，明年春天我一定再
回来参加满月樱花祭。"
page_text_en:
Silver moonlight bathes Alishan, and the spring spirit dances in the forest.
A-di smiles and says, "Alright, I will definitely come back next spring to join the Full Moon Cherry Blossom Festival."
summary_zh: 阿地在月夜下的阿里山与春神告别，承诺明年春天会回来参加满月樱花祭。画面左侧是月光下的山林全景，右侧是阿地与动物们欢庆的场景。

page_text_en:

A-di smiles and says, "Alright, next spring I will definitely come back to join the Full Moon Cherry Blossom Festival."
summary_zh: 在月光下的阿里山，阿地与春神告别，承诺明年春天会回来参加满月樱花祭。画面左侧是月光笼罩的山林全景，右侧是阿地与动物们欢庆的场景。
